answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph: transition mass mixes only within the permitted horizon, so identities in a Sybil cluster cannot gain weight without credible links to honest nodes. Such clusters expose sparse external cuts and therefore low conductance; conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds cap their reachable trust and aggregate voting weight, even when willow, echo, and atlas identities collude.
